    y = 750
    for row in rows:
        if y < 50:

import csv

import openpyxl

def _row_text(row):
    return ", ".join(str(cell) for cell in row)

        from reportlab.pdfgen import canvas
    except ImportError:
        return _export_pdf_minimal(rows, path)

    c = canvas.Canvas(path, pagesize=letter)
    y = _TOP_Y
    for row in rows:
        if y < _BOTTOM_Y:
            c.showPage()
            y = _TOP_Y
        c.drawString(_LEFT_X, y, _row_text(row))
        y -= _LINE_H
    c.save()
    return path


def _pdf_escape(text):
    text = text.replace("\\", "\\\\").replace("(", "\\(").replace(")", "\\)")
    # Standard Type1 Helvetica uses a Latin-1-compatible encoding here.
    return text.encode("latin-1", "replace")


def _export_pdf_minimal(rows, path):
    """Dependency-free fallback used when reportlab is not installed.

    Mirrors the reportlab layout: one line per row, Helvetica 12pt,
    starting at y=750 and breaking to a new page below y=50.
    """
    # Split rows into pages using the same pagination rule as the reportlab path.
    pages, current, y = [], [], _TOP_Y
    for row in rows:
        if y < _BOTTOM_Y:
            pages.append(current)
            current, y = [], _TOP_Y
        current.append((y, _row_text(row)))
        y -= _LINE_H
    pages.append(current)  # always at least one (possibly blank) page

    objects = []  # object bodies as bytes; object number = index + 1

    def add(body):
        objects.append(body)
        return len(objects)

    catalog_id = add(None)  # placeholder, filled in below
    pages_id = add(None)
    font_id = add(b"<< /Type /Font /Subtype /Type1 /BaseFont /Helvetica >>")

    page_ids = []
    for page in pages:
        stream = b"".join(
            b"BT /F1 12 Tf %d %d Td (" % (_LEFT_X, py) + _pdf_escape(text) + b") Tj ET\n"
            for py, text in page
        )
        content_id = add(
            b"<< /Length %d >>\nstream\n" % len(stream) + stream + b"endstream"
        )
        page_ids.append(add(
            b"<< /Type /Page /Parent %d 0 R /MediaBox [0 0 %d %d] "
            b"/Resources << /Font << /F1 %d 0 R >> >> /Contents %d 0 R >>"
            % (pages_id, _PAGE_W, _PAGE_H, font_id, content_id)
        ))

    objects[catalog_id - 1] = b"<< /Type /Catalog /Pages %d 0 R >>" % pages_id
    kids = b" ".join(b"%d 0 R" % pid for pid in page_ids)
    objects[pages_id - 1] = (
        b"<< /Type /Pages /Kids [" + kids + b"] /Count %d >>" % len(page_ids)
    )

    out = bytearray(b"%PDF-1.4\n")
    offsets = []
    for num, body in enumerate(objects, start=1):
        offsets.append(len(out))
        out += b"%d 0 obj\n" % num + body + b"\nendobj\n"
    xref_pos = len(out)
    out += b"xref\n0 %d\n" % (len(objects) + 1)
    out += b"0000000000 65535 f \n"
    for off in offsets:
        out += b"%010d 00000 n \n" % off
    out += b"trailer\n<< /Size %d /Root %d 0 R >>\n" % (len(objects) + 1, catalog_id)
    out += b"startxref\n%d\n%%%%EOF\n" % xref_pos
